faq.q: Can I stay in my Houston house after selling it?
faq.a: Only rely on an arrangement the buyer has agreed to and the appropriate professionals have documented. Ask about possession before committing to a closing date; extra occupancy is not automatic.

faq.q: Is a later closing the same as staying after closing?
faq.a: No. A later closing changes when the sale is completed. Staying afterward separates completion of the sale from the agreed move-out and possession handoff.

faq.q: Does Cash As-Is automatically include time to move?
faq.a: No automatic occupancy period is promised. Explain the move you need to make and ask whether the proposed transaction can accommodate it. The signed agreement and any applicable occupancy documents control.

faq.q: Should I cancel insurance when I sign closing papers?
faq.a: Ask your insurance professional how the ownership and occupancy changes affect coverage before scheduling cancellation. Signing papers alone does not answer that coverage question.
